EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

My No.: DS/GFG/L&L/5/2014/07. Land Ministry’s No.: 4-3/12/2014/UD/239-A. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below for a public purpose.

Description of the land to be acquired: Twenty nine (29) Allotments of land in total extent 0.1998 Hectare depicted as lots 238, 239, 242, 243, 246, 247, 250, 253, 256, 259, 262, 263, 266, , 267, 270, 271, 274, 275, 278, 279, 282, 283, 286, 287, 290, 291, 295, 296 & 298 in Sheet No. 6, Block No.02 of Cadastral Map No. 810012 prepared by the Surveyor General situated in the village of Magalla in the Grama Niladhari Division, No. 99 in Magalla within the Municipal Council Limit of Galle in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Four Gravets Galle in Galle District of the Southern Province and bounded as follows .

All deeds and documents in support of the claims should be produced before me at the inquiry.
W. S. SATHYANANDA, Divisional Secretary, Four Gravets, Galle. 21st September, 2016. At Divisional Secretariat, Galle. 10 - 129
